razonamiento: The visual diagram presents an architecture for drone imagery ingestion and on-premises retrieval. The components on the whiteboard include Drones, Third-Party Software, CloudWatch Events, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, Storage Gateway, and an on-premises container holding a Server (mapping software) and a Database. Narration corroborates these components and explains that CloudWatch triggers Step Functions (orchestrating Lambdas to poll third-party software) and that on-premises software reads raster images from S3 via Storage Gateway. Container c0 connects to Storage Gateway via the on-prem server. Drawn line arrowheads are strictly respected.
nombre: Drone Imagery Ingestion and On-Premises Retrieval Architecture
